filters: Admit only data/main/dialog/json/001.json (ASDC item asdc.v4.001); do not infer approval for any other main, supplemental, or vanilla item.

review.rationale: Pinned GitHub API metadata confirms that commit f37d6575c73602adcb8ae3687520726793baa672 is the ASDC master revision. The pinned README expressly licenses the corpus, annotations, and documentation under CC BY 4.0. The exact 001.json item was inspected, identified as a fictitious accommodation-search role-play, and checked for direct personal identifiers. Only this item is admitted for a public development diagnostic; the rest of ASDC remains unreviewed and excluded.
